claim.name: drop-squash
claim.label: Drop Height
claim.description: A card falls under real gravity, bounces with restitution, and squashes on each impact in proportion to its landing speed before settling — physics, not an easing curve.

claim.name: ripple-interact-sim
claim.label: Tension
claim.description: A real interactive water surface: the pointer pokes a wave-equation height field and the ripples propagate, reflect off the edges, and interfere — true simulated water, not a closed-form sine.
